{{Quote|You made my job possible, then. I'm the official naval liaison to the Jedi expeditionary task force.|Telettoh, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
'''Telettoh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], he became the official naval liaison to the [[Revanchist]] faction of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] allowed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his followers to join the Republic's effort in the war against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. After meeting the former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and his companions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]], Telettoh aided the Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] in the capture of the Republic fugitive [[Dace Golliard]]. He eventually ascended to the position of admiral in the Navy.

==Biography==
===Meeting on Wor Tandell===
{{Quote|Is ''that'' your camp, Carrick? What's going on down there?"''<br />"''I'm afraid to ask.|Telettoh and Carrick on the fight between Malak and "Rohlan Dyre" at Carrick's camp|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
[[File:TelletohMalakFerroh-KotOR42.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Ferroh and Telettoh break up the fight between Malak and "Rohlan Dyre" on Wor Tandell.]]
Telettoh, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period after the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. During his life, he joined the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and eventually became the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Testament]]''. In the year [[3963 BBY]], he became the official liaison to the [[Revanchist]]s, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] faction of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who were organized under the banner of a [[Republic Mercy Corps]]. Telettoh was placed under the command of Jedi Knight and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]]. Telettoh traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]] with Malak&mdash;who hoped to recruit his friend [[Jarael]] to the Revanchists&mdash;and the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi [[Ferroh]].<ref name="KotOR 42" />

After landing in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gantra Lea]], Telettoh was introduced by Ferroh to the former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], who was a companion of Jarael's. After the Cathar and the former Jedi conversed about the Revanchists' standing in the war, Telettoh, Ferroh, and Carrick made their way via [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] to the latter's camp based near his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Hot Prospect]]''. As they neared the camp, the three witnessed Malak engaging in a fight with<ref name="KotOR 42" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]], who was secretly masquerading as the Mandalorian commander [[Rohlan Dyre]].<ref name="KotOR 47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref> Telettoh, who was aware of the Mandalorian's high profile due to his recent victory in the [[Tandem Open]] sporting event, helped Ferroh restrain Malak. The Republic captain berated Malak for attacking "Dyre," reasoning that the Revanchists could not afford any scandals. After Malak had a conversation with Carrick and Jarael, during which the latter turned down the Jedi's offer, Telettoh departed the planet aboard the ''Testament'' with Malak and Ferroh.<ref name="KotOR 42" />

===Assisting Zayne Carrick===
{{Quote|So our Jedi expeditionary task force is actually one big Mercy Corps&mdash;under Revan! It's fragile&mdash;and tentative but the Council has allowed it&mdash;for now. Revan's really quite clever!"''<br />''"It's a fraud. You're taking them off to fight.|Telettoh and Rohlan Dyre|<ref name="KotOR 49">[[Knights of the Old Republic 49|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 49]]</ref>}}
Eventually, the Republic [[Ministry of Defense|Defense Ministry]] received an anonymous tip about a full-scale Mandalorian raiding force set to arrive in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]]. Telettoh and his command ship ''Testament'' traveled to the [[Star system/Legends|system]] as part of a Republic force under the Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]]'s direction. The Republic ships waited for a Mandalorian fleet led by [[Cassus Fett]] to exit [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] outside of the system's [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. After the Mandalorians exited hyperspace, the Republic forces prepared to engage them; however, the Mandalorian ships went around the fleet and re-entered hyperspace. Saul Karath was then notified by Zayne Carrick, who was in the system to contact Karath to ask him a favor, that [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by Republic fugitive [[Dace Golliard]]&mdash;who aimed to capture and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] any survivors of the prospective battle&mdash;were near the starboard flank of Karath's [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|command ship]] [[Swiftsure (Inexpugnable-class)|''Swiftsure'']]. After aiding in the capture of Golliard, Telettoh was instructed by Karath to take Carrick to wherever he and his companions needed to go.<ref name="KotOR 49" />

[[File:TelettohAndDyre-KOTOR49.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Telettoh prepares to give Rohlan Dyre a tour of the ''Testament''.]]
As they were in transit to the planet [[Osadia]], Telettoh had a discussion with Carrick, [[Marn Hierogryph]], and the actual Rohlan Dyre&mdash;who, after Carrick and Hierogryph figured out that Demagol had been masquerading as Dyre, escaped Republic authorities with Carrick and Hierogryph's aid<ref name="KotOR 47" />&mdash;regarding the actual details of the Revanchist Jedi's involvement in the Mandalorian Wars. He explained that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] had not sanctioned the Revanchist's participation with the Republic,<ref name="KotOR 49" /> even after Revan found proof of the Mandalorians' [[Battle of Cathar|devastation]] of the planet [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]].<ref name="KotOR 42" /> The captain informed Carrick and his companions that Revan organized his followers under the banner of a Republic Mercy Corps, leading to the Council sanctioning the Revanchist's participation in the war. Telettoh then gave Dyre, whom he knew as "Spikes," a tour of the ''Testament'',<ref name="KotOR 49" /> before arriving at Osadia.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 50">[[Knights of the Old Republic 50|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 50]]</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Never let Malak aboard.|Jarrow Rusher quotes Telettoh's maxim to Kerra Holt|<ref name="KE">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
Eventually, Telettoh was elevated to the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the Republic Navy. Millennia later, in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Telettoh's Maxim]], an ancient Republic protocol which banned the transport of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] aboard Republic vessels, was recited by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] when he was chiding the Jedi Knight [[Kerra Holt]] for bringing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]] aboard his [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|ship]].<ref name="KE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This is wartime, Malak! That Mandalorian's a sports hero&mdash;and your movement can't afford ''scandal'' right now!|Telettoh, to Malak|<ref name="KotOR 42" />}}
Telettoh was quick to put a halt to the fight between Malak and Rohlan Dyre, and even berated the Jedi for attacking the Mandalorian, believing that news of the fight would create indignity for the Revanchists.<ref name="KotOR 42" /> He made a point of revealing the actual events of the Revanchist's involvement with the Republic war effort to Carrick and his companions, and believed that Revan was clever for organizing his followers under the banner of a Republic Mercy Corps.<ref name="KotOR 49" /> He had light skin and blond hair, and wore a Republic officer's uniform, and donned a set of [[spectacles]].<ref name="KotOR 42" />

==Behind the scenes==
Telettoh was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] for the standalone [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Masks'']], the forty-second issue of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] comic series. The comic was illustrated by [[Ron Chan]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="KotOR 42" /> on [[June 17]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54361/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_42|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #42}}</ref> The character was named after Pete Hottelet, who donated $14,000 at the [[Wikipedia:Penny Arcade (webcomic)|Penny Arcade]] charity dinner which benefited the Seattle Childrens' Hospitals. Miller originally considered anagramming the character's name, but decided to spell Hottelet's surname backwards.<ref name="Faraway">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor42.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #42''}}</ref>
